about.title: Fausia Fofo Fa'atekinolosi E Fa'agaioi Atu Pisinisi i Luma
about.description:
Oklut Technologies ose kamupani fa'atekonolosi fofo o lo'o taula'i ile fesoasoani i pisinisi e fa'aliliu manatu ile poto fa'atekinolosi anoa. Matou te tuʻufaʻatasia tekinolosi, fatufatuaʻi, ma le malamalama faʻapisinisi e tuʻuina atu fofo ua mamanuina i manaʻoga moni o le lalolagi.

Mai le suiga numera ma le atinaʻeina o polokalama faʻapitoa i le ao, AI, faʻaautomatika, ma pulega faʻatekonolosi auaunaga, matou te fesoasoani i faʻalapotopotoga e faʻafaigofie le lavelave, faʻaleleia le lelei, ma fatuina le tau numera tumau.

E faigofie la matou auala - malamalama i le faʻafitauli, faʻaleleia le tekinolosi.
about.awardText: Fa'ailoaina mo le fa'ao'o lelei i luga o upegatafa'ilagi ma masini feavea'i oloa.
about.staffText: Enisinia sinia, e mafai ona tali atu e ana le galuega mai le valaau muamua e alu-live.

section1.title: 1. Faamatalaga Matou te Aoina
body: Matou te aoina faʻamatalaga e te tuʻuina saʻo (e pei o lou igoa ma lou tuatusi imeli pe a e tuʻuina atu le fomu faʻafesoʻotaʻi poʻo le fatuina o se teugatupe) ma faʻamatalaga e otometi lava ona aoina e ala i kuki ma tekinolosi tutusa, e pei o itulau na asia, ituaiga masini ma nofoaga faʻatatau.

section2.title: 2. Fa'afefea ona Tatou Fa'aaoga Kuki
body: E fa'aaga pea kuki taua ona e le mafai ona fa'aoga sa'o le upegatafa'ilagi e aunoa ma ia. Latou te teuina le sauniga ma le tulaga faʻamaonia ma manatua au kuki e fiafia i ai.

Analytics kuki e fesoasoani ia i matou e malamalama i le auala e faʻaogaina ai e tagata asiasi le saite ina ia mafai ona matou faʻaleleia. E fa'aogaina kuki fa'atauga e fa'aali atu ai ia te oe ofo talafeagai ma fa'asalalauga. O nei vaega e na'o lau fa'atagaga e mafai ai ma e mafai ona suia i so'o se taimi mai le laulau e fiafia i ai kuki.

section3.title: 3. Fa'avae Tulafono (GDPR)
body: Matou te fa'agasolo fa'amatalaga patino i luga o fa'avae fa'aletulafono nei: o lau fa'atagaga (mo kuki e le taua ma le maketiina), fa'atinoga o se konekarate (mo au'aunaga e te mana'o ai), noataga fa'aletulafono, ma aia tatau pe a le fa'amalo e au aia tatau. E mafai ona e faaui i tua le maliega i soo se taimi e aunoa ma le aafia ai o le tulafono o le faagasologa e faia a o lei faaui i tua.

section4.title: 4. O Au Aia Tatau
body: Fa'alagolago i lou nofoaga, atonu e iai sau aia tatau e maua ai, fa'asa'o, tape, pe fa'atapula'aina le fa'agaioiina o au fa'amatalaga patino, e tete'e ai i le fa'agaioiina, ma le feavea'iina o fa'amaumauga. E mafai fo'i ona e tu'uina atu sau fa'aseā i lau pulega fa'apitonu'u.

section5.title: 5. Fa'amauina ma Puipuiga
body: Matou te taofia fa'amatalaga patino i le umi e mana'omia mo fa'amoemoega o lo'o fa'amatalaina i lenei faiga fa'avae. Matou te fa'aogaina faiga fa'atekinisi ma fa'alāpotopotoga talafeagai e puipuia ai au fa'amatalaga mai le fa'atagaina e le fa'atagaina, suiga, fa'aalia po'o le fa'aleagaina.

section6.title: 6. Auaunaga Vaega Tolu
body: O nisi kuki e mafai ona fa'atulaga e isi vaega e tu'uina atu (e pei o au'ili'ili po'o fa'asalalauga fa'asalalauga) e fesoasoani ia i matou i le fa'agaioia o le upega tafa'ilagi. overview: Artificial Intelligence ma Robotics o loʻo suia le auala e faʻagaioi ai faʻalapotopotoga, fai filifiliga, ma tuʻuina atu le tau. aiRobotics.intro: Artificial Intelligence (AI) ma Robotics o loʻo suia le auala e faʻagaioi ai pisinisi e ala i le tuʻufaʻatasia o filifiliga atamai ma le masini faʻapitoa. AI e mafai ai e masini ona au'ili'ili fa'amaumauga, a'oa'o fa'ata'ita'iga, ma fai fa'ai'uga atamai, a'o fa'apolopolo e aumaia nei agava'a i le lalolagi fa'aletino e fa'atino ai galuega ma le saoasaoa, sa'o, ma le tumau.
aiRobotics.section1Text: O a matou AI ma Robotics fofo e fesoasoani i faʻalapotopotoga e faʻafaigofie galuega, faʻaitiitia taumafaiga tusilima, ma faʻaleleia le gaosiga i totonu o pisinisi eseese. Mai le fa'agasologa o masini ma su'esu'ega fa'apitoa i robotics atamai ma faiga fa'apoto, matou te tu'uina atu tekonolosi fou e fa'aleleia ai le lelei, fa'ateleina le tuputupu a'e, ma lagolagoina suiga fa'atekinolosi.
aiRobotics.section2Heading: Le mea e fetaui ai le atamai ma faatinoga
aiRobotics.section2Text: So'o se fegalegaleai, fa'ai'uga, ma gaioiga e fa'amalosia e se faiga feso'ota'i e tasi - liliu fa'amaumauga i taunu'uga i le taimi moni.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Se puna e tasi o le mea moni mo matagaluega uma - fausia e liliu faʻamatalaga faʻagaioiga mataʻutia i filifiliga e mafai e lau pisinisi ona faʻatino i aso nei.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Tasi fa'atonuga fa'apitoa mo metric uma e taua
informationReporting.section1P1: Fa'amatalaga & Lipoti Faiga o ni fofo fa'apisinisi taua e mafai ai e fa'alapotopotoga ona aoina, pulea, ma suia fa'amaumauga i ni fa'amatalaga anoa. O nei faiga e tuʻufaʻatasia faʻamatalaga mai le tele o matagaluega, faʻamautinoa le saʻo, tumau, ma le taimi moni avanoa i faʻamatalaga pisinisi taua. E ala i le tu'uina atu o se fa'avae fa'atotonugalemu mo le fa'afoega o fa'amatalaga, e mafai ai e fa'alapotopotoga ona fa'aleleia le va'aia o galuega, fa'agasolo galuega, ma lagolagoina faiga fa'ai'uga fa'atatau i la'asaga uma o le atina'e.
informationReporting.section1P2: O nei faiga e fa'aogaina ai lipoti otometi, au'ili'ili, ma dashboards e siaki ai le fa'atinoga, mata'itūina fa'ata'ita'iga autu, ma fa'atupuina lipoti moni. E ala i le faʻaitiitia o taumafaiga faʻataʻitaʻi ma le faʻaleleia o le saʻo o faʻamaumauga, e mafai e pisinisi ona faia faʻaiuga vave ma sili atu ona lelei.
informationReporting.section2Heading: Fausia mo le va'aia, tausisia, ma le fua
informationReporting.section2Text: Faatasi ai ma le faʻaleleia atili o le vaʻaia, tausisia, ma le galulue faʻatasi, Faʻamatalaga & Lipoti Faiga e mafai ai e faʻalapotopotoga ona faʻamalieina faiga, faʻaleleia le gaosiga, ma faʻamalosia le tuputupu aʻe o pisinisi i se siosiomaga tauvaga.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Tu'u atu i 'au uma le ata tutusa o le pisinisi.
informationReporting.ctaText: Va'ai pe fa'afefea e Nexus Data Systems ona tu'ufa'atasia lau lipoti i totonu o se tulaga atamai e tasi.

modernErp.sec1P3: E ala i le fa'auluina o galuega autu i totonu o se si'osi'omaga tutusa, ua fa'amutaina e le ERP fa'aonaponei vaega tauaso e fa'agesegese ai le tuputupu a'e, e mafai ai e ta'ita'i ona ta'ita'ia le pisinisi e fa'aaoga fa'ailoga fa'a-taimi nai lo tala fa'asolopito.

modernErp.sec3P2: O le ERP fa'aonaponei o lo'o fa'aalia lenei mea e ala i fa'amaumauga tu'ufa'atasi ma fa'asologa fa'asologa o mea e tutupu:

sec2Cards.desc: Fa'ailoga malosi i femalagaiga (TLS 1.3) ma le malologa (AES-256), fa'atasi ai ma le fa'atonuga o le puipuiga o le leiloa o fa'amaumauga (DLP) e puipuia ai le tafe mai o meatotino tau le atamai.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: O le puipuia o aseta tau atina'e e mana'omia ai le fa'amautinoaina o fa'asinomaga uma—pe o se tagata fa'atonu, se konekarate mai fafo, po'o se fa'amatalaga tuto'atasi o auaunaga faakomepiuta-ua fa'amaonia le fa'atagaga mo punaoa tonu na te mauaina.

sec3List.text: Single Sign-On (SSO) ma federated identity standards e faʻaumatia ai faʻaputu upu faʻapolopolo i luga o talosaga.
Ki meafaigaluega FIDO2 e tete'e i le phishing ma lu'itau fa'atatau i tulaga lamatia mo galuega tau pulega ma'ale'ale.
Fa'atonuga fa'avae (RBAC) ma Attribute-Based (ABAC) fa'atonutonu avanoa fa'amalosi i le API ma fa'amaumauga fa'amaumauga.
Tuuina atu le avanoa le tumau, sa'o i le taimi (JIT) e otometi ona muta pe a mae'a galuega tau pulega.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveTitle: Fa'aauauina Fa'amaoniga I luga o Fa'atuatuaga Tauaso
cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: I totonu o le fausaga o le Zero Trust, o le fa'atuatuaga fa'avae e fa'atatau i le nofoaga o feso'ota'iga ua fa'amavae atoa. So'o se fefa'ataua'iga, fa'amatalaga fa'amaumauga, ma fa'aoga tagata e fa'aoga e tatau ona fa'amaonia pea lona fa'amaoni:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Tiutetauave Felagolagomai
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Fa'amanino pulega fa'avasegaina le puipuiga fa'aletino a le kamupani tu'uina atu ao mai le matafaioi a le atina'e mo fa'amatalaga fa'amatalaga, faiga fa'avae IAM, ma le fa'ailoga o talosaga.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Atina'e e pei ole Code (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: O fetuutuunaiga o ao e le mafai ona suia, e mafai ona su'eina e ala ile code. O su'esu'e faiga fa'avae fa'a-code e poloka ai fa'aoga sese ma pakete fa'aalia a'o le'i tu'uina atu.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Container & Kubernetes Security
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Taimi fa'ama'a'a koneteina, resitara ata saini, vaeluaga o feso'ota'iga, ma pulega fa'alilolilo otometi e taofia ai fa'amatalaga mai fale teu oloa.

cloudModernization.title: Fa'aonaponei Talosaga Talatuu mo le Ao
cloudModernization.subtitle: Su'esu'e se faiga fa'atino e su'esu'e ai, fa'aonaponei ma fa'agaioi atu fa'aagaaga tu'uaga aga'i i ata fa'akomepiuta ma fa'amautu.

modernizationApproaches.title: Toe Fuafua (Siitia ma Toe Fa'apena)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Fa'aleleia fa'asologa o taimi, fa'aoga fa'amaumauga o ao fa'atautaia, ma fa'afaigofie galuega.

modernizationApproaches.title: Toe Fa'afo'i (Cloud-Native Rebuild)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Fa'ate'a monoliths i totonu o koneteina microservices ma mea e fa'aosoina serverless APIs.

modernizationApproaches.title: Sui (SaaS Modernization)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Fa'amuta faiga fa'aleaganu'u fa'agae'etia e fa'atatau i polokalama fa'akomepiuta a le atina'e.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Iloiloga o Talatuu
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Fa'afanua fa'alagolago fa'aautometi, fa'avasegaina o aitalafu fa'apitoa, ma le fa'ailoga o le ao-sauni.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Fa'ata'ita'iga Fa'atatau
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Fa'ata'ita'iga fa'ata'ita'i fa'ata'ita'i, fa'asologa o koneteina, ma fa'ata'ita'iga otometi IaC.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Femalaga'iga Fa'asolosolo
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Fa'asalalauina Canary, fa'amaopoopo fa'amaumauga e lua-tusi, ma galu fa'ato'a e leai se taimi.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Fa'atonuga o Ao
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Fa'aauau le fa'afoega o tau, fa'asologa o le telemetry, ma iloiloga fa'atino a le FinOps.

cloudModernization.sec1Eyebrow: O LE TOTONU O FAIGA TULAFONO
cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: O monolith tuai e fa'alavelaveina le saoasaoa o mea fou, fa'atuputeleina fa'aletonu fa'agaioiga, ma fa'ateleina le tau o le tausiga o mea tetele.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: O le fa'afouina o ao manuia e amata ile su'esu'ega malosi. Ole oso sa'o ile femalaga'iga e aunoa ma le su'eina o fa'alagolago ile talosaga ole mafua'aga autu ole tuai o tipi.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: E leai se ta'iala mo femalaga'iga e tasi. O atina'e ta'ita'i e fa'afetaui le mamanu fa'aonaponei sa'o i galuega fa'apitoa ta'itasi e fa'atatau i tau pisinisi, fa'anatinati, ma aitalafu fa'apitoa.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Ose fa'afanua auala fa'atulagaina e fa'aliliuina monoliths tala'aga i 'au'aunaga fa'alava, malupuipuia, ma fa'atumauina.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: O le fa'asolo atu o faiga fa'aleaganu'u i ata fa'aonaponei ao fa'aonaponei e maua ai le mataalia o le fa'agaioiga ma le va'aiga tau.
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Su'esu'e se faiga fa'atino e su'esu'e ai, fa'aonaponei ma fa'agaioi fa'amatalaga tu'ufa'asolo aga'i i ata fa'akomepiuta ma fa'amautu.
cloudModernization.ctaButton: Talanoa i o Tatou Tagata Popoto
cloudModernization.sec1P1: O talosaga fa'atauva'a na fausia i le sefulu tausaga talu ai o lo'o fa'aola pea le faitau piliona o tupe maua mai atina'e, peita'i o lo latou fa'amaualuga faufale e fa'atupu ai le fa'atupula'ia o tulaga lamatia.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: O pisinisi uma e feagai ma le vevesi i le va o le mautu ma le faʻafouina. O faiga fa'aleaganu'u na fa'ainisinia mo le tumau, ma sa fa'atino fa'atuatuaina mo le tele o tausaga. Ae ui i lea, a o faʻavavevave manaoga pisinisi, o nei fausaga tuai e feagai ma tapulaʻa faʻavae:

sec1List.text: Monolithic codebases fausia i luga o fa'ava'a fa'aletonu ma fa'aitiitiga avanoa taleni avanoa mo le tausiga.
O vaega fa'apipi'i mau pe a suia se vaega e tasi e ono malepe ai vaega fa'atino e le feso'ota'i.
Fa'atapula'a fa'atutu sa'o e mana'omia ai le fa'atauina o masini fa'atauga taugata e fa'atautaia ai le fa'atuputeleina o fe'avea'i.
Le mafai ona fa'afeso'ota'i sologa lelei ma fa'aoga feavea'i fa'aonaponei, faitoto'a o tagata fa'atau, po'o API pa'aga e aunoa ma ni fa'amaumauga ma'ale'ale.
Si'osi'omaga o le potu fa'aletino fa'aletino, fa'aletonu fa'asao, ma tupe alu fa'agaioia maualuga/malulu.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: O se malaga fa'aonaponei fa'apitoa e amata i le fa'amautuina o le manino atoatoa i le esetete o lo'o iai nei:

sec2List.text: Fa'avasegaga uma o galuega fa'atino, fa'asologa fa'aaganu'u, fa'amaumauga tua'oi, ma fa'amaumauga fa'asolopito lona tolu.
Fa'afanua feso'ota'iga lavelave taimi ta'avale, laulau fa'asoa fa'amaumauga, telefoni fa'atonu faila faila, ma konekarate tautua fafo.
Su'esu'eina fa'amaumauga o fa'amaumauga, tulaga fa'amaoni tau fefa'ataua'iga, fa'asologa fa'aola, ma tulafono fa'aletulafono fa'aletulafono.
Su'e le PPU, manatua, fa'aogaina o mea e teu ai, ma le fa'aogaina o feso'ota'iga i fa'amatalaga fa'atatau o le ao.
Fa'avasegaina o talosaga i ni vaega e fa'ata'atia saogalemu, fa'asolosolo galu femalaga'i fa'atasi ai ma fa'agasolo manino o tua.

cloudModernization.sec4P1: O le fa'ata'ita'iga o lo'o taunu'u i ai e fa'a'ese'ese fa'atasi ai fa'aoga autu i 'au'aunaga fa'apitoa, fa'apipi'iina o lo'o fa'afeiloa'i i luga o fa'aputuga o ao (e pei o Kubernetes po'o taimi fa'atautaia e leai se server).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: E ala i le fa'atuina o paipa fa'apipi'i CI/CD, tipi otometi lanumoana-lanumeamata, ma atina'e e fai ma fa'ailoga, e suia ai mea mai fa'ai'uga fa'ai'uga fa'ai'uga fa'ai'uga i faiga masani i aso uma.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: E otometi lava ona fua i luga le fa'aogaina o mea e mana'omia ma fa'aitiitia i le taimi o le fa'agasolo, fa'aitiitia ai le tau fa'aletonu a'o fa'amautinoa taimi e tali atu ai i lalo-lua mo tagata fa'aoga i le lalolagi.
